, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the correctly extracted birth dates (Arthur Conan Doyle: May 22, 1859; Penelope Lively: March 17, 1933) and erroneously concluded that Penelope Lively was born first, even stating she was “older by 26 years.” This is a logical/date-comparison error; 1859 precedes 1933, so Arthur Conan Doyle was born first.
